# See https://github.com/check-spelling/check-spelling/wiki/Configuration-Examples:-patterns

Raw:      \s+`.*`
Line:        `.*`
.*(?:#|//)\s*gitleaks:allow
(?:Fingerprint|Match|Secret):\s*".*"
GenerateSampleSecrets\(.*\)
regex = '''.*'''
secret = ".*"
aws_?[Tt]oken\d* := \\?".*"
regexes = \[.*\]
password=\\?".*"
secret="?[~.\w]+
\bdGhp\w+
Line:\s+".*"
chunk:\s*`.*`
GenerateUniqueTokenRegex\(`.*`
key="ClearTextPassword" value=".*"
NewReader\(".*"
Keywords:\s*\[\]string\{".*"
\\b(?=[a-z]{3})
Basic [-a-zA-Z=;:/0-9+.]{6,}
"Authorization:.*"
"access_token4": ".*"
\w+ = .*region_url

# Bearer
\b[Bb]ear[e][r]:? [-a-zA-Z_~=;:/0-9+.]{3,}

# Automatically suggested patterns

# hit-count: 327 file-count: 26
# regex choice
\(\?:[^)]+\|[^)]+\)

# hit-count: 254 file-count: 55
# https/http/file urls
(?:\b(?:https?|ftp|file)://)[-A-Za-z0-9+&@#/*%?=~_|!:,.;]+[-A-Za-z0-9+&@#/*%=~_|]

# hit-count: 234 file-count: 51
# hex runs
\b[0-9a-fA-F]{16,}\b

# hit-count: 116 file-count: 25
# Go regular expressions
regexp?\.MustCompile\((?:`[^`]*`|".*"|'.*')\)

# hit-count: 100 file-count: 9
# base64 encoded content, possibly wrapped in mime
(?:^|[\s=;:?])[-a-zA-Z=;:/0-9+]{50,}(?:[\s=;:?]|$)

# hit-count: 82 file-count: 8
# base64 encoded json
(?:\\n|\b)eyJ[-a-zA-Z=;:/0-9+.]+

# hit-count: 54 file-count: 7
# hex digits including css/html color classes:
(?:[\\0][xX]|\\u|[uU]\+|#x?|%23|&H)[0-9_a-fA-FgGrR]*?[a-fA-FgGrR]{2,}[0-9_a-fA-FgGrR]*(?:[uUlL]{0,3}|[iu]\d+)\b

# hit-count: 46 file-count: 7
# in check-spelling@v0.0.22+, printf markers aren't automatically consumed
# printf markers
(?<!\\)\\[nrt](?=[a-z]{2,})

# hit-count: 37 file-count: 14
# python
\b(?i)py(?!gments|gmy|lon|ramid|ro|th)(?=[a-z]{2,})

# hit-count: 31 file-count: 8
# uuid:
\b[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-){3}[0-9a-fA-F]{12}\b

# hit-count: 31 file-count: 3
# URL escaped characters
%[0-9A-F][A-F](?=[A-Za-z])

# hit-count: 15 file-count: 6
# base64 encoded content
([`'"])[-a-zA-Z=;:/0-9+]{3,}=\g{-1}

# hit-count: 15 file-count: 1
# Repeated letters
\b([a-z])\g{-1}{2,}\b

# hit-count: 14 file-count: 5
# bearer auth
\b[Bb]ear[e][r]:? [-a-zA-Z=;:/0-9+.~]{3,}

# hit-count: 10 file-count: 5
# Compiler flags (Unix, Java/Scala)
# Use if you have things like `-Pdocker` and want to treat them as `docker`
(?:^|[\t ,>"'`=(])-(?:(?:J-|)[DPWXY]|[Lf])(?=[A-Z]{2,}|[A-Z][a-z]|[a-z]{2,})

# hit-count: 9 file-count: 5
# version suffix <word>v#
(?:(?<=[A-Z]{2})V|(?<=[a-z]{2}|[A-Z]{2})v)\d+(?:\b|(?=[a-zA-Z_]))

# hit-count: 8 file-count: 3
# GitHub actions
\buses:\s+[-\w.]+/[-\w./]+@[-\w.]+

# hit-count: 7 file-count: 3
# css url wrappings
\burl\([^)]+\)

# hit-count: 7 file-count: 3
# data url
\bdata:[-a-zA-Z=;:/0-9+]*,\S*

# hit-count: 7 file-count: 3
# pki (base64)
LS0tLS1CRUdJT.*

# hit-count: 5 file-count: 1
# curl arguments
\b(?:\\n|)curl(?:\.exe|)(?:\s+-[a-zA-Z]{1,2}\b)*(?:\s+-[a-zA-Z]{3,})(?:\s+-[a-zA-Z]+)*

# hit-count: 4 file-count: 2
# bearer auth
(['"])[Bb]ear[e][r] .{3,}?\g{-1}

# hit-count: 3 file-count: 3
# gist github
\bgist\.github\.com/[^/\s"]+/[0-9a-f]+

# hit-count: 3 file-count: 1
# mailgun
\b[0-9a-z]+.mailgun.org

# hit-count: 1 file-count: 1
# base64 encoded pkcs
\bMII[-a-zA-Z=;:/0-9+]+

# Questionably acceptable forms of `in to`
# Personally, I prefer `log into`, but people object
# https://www.tprteaching.com/log-into-log-in-to-login/
\b(?:(?:[Ll]og(?:g(?=[a-z])|)|[Ss]ign)(?:ed|ing)?) in to\b

# to opt in
\bto opt in\b

# pass(ed|ing) in
\bpass(?:ed|ing) in\b

# acceptable duplicates
# ls directory listings
[-bcdlpsw](?:[-r][-w][-SsTtx]){3}[\.+*]?\s+\d+\s+\S+\s+\S+\s+[.\d]+(?:[KMGT]|)\s+
# mount
\bmount\s+-t\s+(\w+)\s+\g{-1}\b
# C types and repeated CSS values
\s(auto|buffalo|center|div|inherit|long|LONG|none|normal|solid|thin|transparent|very)(?: \g{-1})+\s
# C enum and struct
\b(?:enum|struct)\s+(\w+)\s+\g{-1}\b
# go templates
\s(\w+)\s+\g{-1}\s+\`(?:graphql|inject|json|yaml):
# doxygen / javadoc / .net
(?:[\\@](?:brief|defgroup|groupname|link|t?param|return|retval)|(?:public|private|\[Parameter(?:\(.+\)|)\])(?:\s+(?:static|override|readonly|required|virtual))*)(?:\s+\{\w+\}|)\s+(\w+)\s+\g{-1}\s

# macOS file path
(?:Contents\W+|(?!iOS)/)MacOS\b

# Python package registry has incorrect spelling for macOS / Mac OS X
"Operating System :: MacOS :: MacOS X"

# "company" in Germany
\bGmbH\b

# IntelliJ
\bIntelliJ\b

# Commit message -- Signed-off-by and friends
^\s*(?:(?:Based-on-patch|Co-authored|Helped|Mentored|Reported|Reviewed|Signed-off)-by|Thanks-to): (?:[^<]*<[^>]*>|[^<]*)\s*$

# Autogenerated revert commit message
^This reverts commit [0-9a-f]{40}\.$

# ignore long runs of a single character:
\b([A-Za-z])\g{-1}{3,}\b
